{{Quote|I am Nariel Pridence. Jedi Knight. I come in peace, but I will defend myself.|Nariel Pridence|<ref name="DR" />}}
'''Nariel Pridence''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} The events on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the Smuggler class, which include the encounters with Nariel Pridence, occur during Act I, placing them in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> she was sent to the desert-[[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to find the [[Darth Nihilus' holocron|holocron]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]]. However, she had to face against [[Vaverone Zare]], a servant of the Empire, who was also looking for the holocron. She was present inside [[Tookreek]]'s cantina when she was forced to engage [[Chomm]] and his gang that were giving her trouble. Before engaging, a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] who had entered the cantina to talk with Tookreek took notice and warned the gang to leave her alone. Nariel swiftly slew all her attackers. She then exchanged formal introductions with the smuggler, she attempted to encourage them to change their ways and stop associating with criminals, before departing.<ref name="DR" />

Nariel later investigated an Imperial assault on [[Diago Hixan]]'s [[Diago Hixan's palace|summer palace]] and was surprised to find the smuggler involved in the fighting. The smuggler explained that the Imperials were sent by Zare, who attempting to broker a meeting with Diago, who possessed the holocron. The smuggler gave Nariel the location of Diago's hideout, the [[Lightspring]]. After expressing her thanks, the Jedi advised the smuggler not to follow, but the smuggler ignored her advice and did so anyway.<ref name="BO">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|Bugged-Out|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Once all parties arrived at the Lightspring, tension began to grow before both Zare and Nariel attempted to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to compel the smuggler to fight for her or drop their weapons respectively, but the smuggler proved too strong willed to be manipulated. Diago then ordered his droids to kill everyone. Nariel and the smuggler fought side-by-side against both Diago and Zare, killing them both.<ref name="TL">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|The Lightspring|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nariel Pridence is voiced by [[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]].

If the [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] character is male, he can flirt with Nariel, making her wish that if she wasn't a Jedi, she'd have known what to do in romantic situations.<ref name="TL" /> If the Smuggler sent both Nariel and Zare to the Lightspring and stayed neutral all the way, they will end up siding with Nariel as well.
